hyps.why: With edge 5 removed the direct 0->3 path carries more of the output, so upgrading it to a 3x3 conv matters more.
Removing the direct path when edge 5 is also absent leaves only edge 4 feeding the output, risking a starved or disconnected cell.
Node 2 only reaches the output via edge 5, so with edge 5 removed any op on edge 2 has no effect.
If edge 0 is none, node 1 is zero, so a conv on edge 4 carries no signal.
If edge 0 is none, node 1 outputs zero, so a conv on edge 2 transforms nothing.
Replacing a removed edge reactivates node 1 and its downstream paths, a larger gain than swapping between active ops.
Without the direct 0->3 path, removing edge 5 leaves only edge 4 feeding the output, so the loss is much larger.
When the direct path is missing, each remaining input to node 3 is more critical, so removing edge 4 hurts more.
avg_pool is among the weakest active ops, so replacing it with a 3x3 conv gives a larger jump than replacing conv1x1 or skip.
Node 2's output is unused when edge 5 is none, so edits to edge 1 cannot affect accuracy.
